design: R5 section 6.2 three-candidate factor design around the VTREPLAY parent

T_temporal.definition: time-mask candidate only; spatial boxes byte-identical to the parent on the common frames
T_temporal.source_line: native VideoMAEv2-B rebuilt line (P/O/S/B/L matrix) - gated on the R5 3.5 main time gate
T_temporal.local_gate: fresh-confirm original-frame macro F >= +0.007 vs BOTH the VTREPLAY head and the position baseline; source-cluster paired CI95 lower bound > 0; anchor/neutral strata reported separately

S_spatial.definition: spatial candidate only; time mask identical to the parent
S_spatial.source_line: spatial candidate improvement from the S0 audit direction (feature/backbone/candidate-geometry/TTA - NOT the loss, which B3 already is)
S_spatial.local_gate: locked-out crop-domain mean IoU delta >= +0.02, source-level paired CI95 lower bound > 0, primary-group degradation lower bound >= -0.01; frame set and frame ids unchanged; x-axis-only change if only x-axis ground truth supports it
S_spatial.s0_audit_reading: live_confirmation scorer gap 0.247 CI95 [0.227, 0.268]; 70.2 percent of frames have gap >= 0.05; head beats centre by +0.071 - exploitable gap CONFIRMED, loss excluded as duplicate (A5)

ST_combined.submission_rule: only after BOTH S and T return usable official gains (>= +0.50 each, raw units)

interaction_readout: I = S_ST - S_S - S_T + S_P on same-unit platform scores; descriptive on the finite official set only

preregistered_score_readout.usable_gain: >= +0.50 official score vs parent (resource-allocation threshold, not a significance claim)
preregistered_score_readout.no_practical_gain: within +/-0.50 - described as not reaching the practical threshold, never as strict equivalence
preregistered_score_readout.pause: <= -0.50 vs parent - pause the candidate line, check proxy-official directional mismatch

optional_diagnostic.K70: keep=0.70 package only if the NPU is expected to be down for more than one platform round AND no gated S/T exists; single preregistered denominator-sensitivity diagnostic, never a 0.72/0.75 sweep

budget: 3 new packages (S, T, conditional ST) + at most 1 K70 diagnostic this round
declarations: every package stays single-variable vs its stated parent
no package is submitted without passing its local implementation and generalization gate
no score prediction is attached to any package; official scores are read as returned, raw, no conversions
